lore.description: This creature can jump so high that at times it seems as if it is flying. Once up in the air, it comes missiling down on its enemy like a battering ram.
appearance: Small bounding quadruped, built around its hind legs
A pair of curved ram-like horns
Whip tail longer than the body, ending in a spiked plume
lore.habits: Its ground is not continuous. The habitable band of Saiphus is a scatter of buoyant islands separated by a sea of clouds and dense fog, and it crosses the gaps, one of the great leaping animals the Saiphus Generator raised to bound between islands as if gravity held no sway over them. It grazes the rolling plains such an island carries and drinks from the deep canyons where vapor condenses into water. It listens and it moves: sulfuric cloud banks sweep across the sky without warning, the storms do not stop, and a descent into the fluid layer below the islands is not recoverable.
lore.biomeNiche: the gaps between the floating islands of Saiphus's upper-atmosphere life band

signatureAbility.name: The Long Fall of Saiphus
signatureAbility.description: The Luceras leaps until it seems to fly, then comes missiling down horns first on its enemy like a battering ram.
